intended_object: This is a helper for the cancellation step in the word-reduction proof of the classification of surfaces. It builds the one-face polygon presentation whose boundary word is a⁻¹ a X, i.e. a word that begins with an adjacent inverse pair written with the negative letter first.
explanation: The definition just applies `Dyck.oneFace` to the word `[.neg a, .pos a] ++ X`. Its only purpose is to serve as the source of the cancellation move. Its uses support this. The library pairs it with `negativeNamedSourceSignedIso`, which reduces it to the positively displayed case `namedSource`, and uses it in the case analysis of the word-reduction proofs. It is a proof-internal device, not a standard mathematical notion that could be compared with the literature or with Mathlib.
